description: A huge stepped stone pyramid with a wide central staircase rises from dense jungle under a cloudy sky. Three small temple houses with thatched roofs crown the summit, and stucco masks decorate the upper facades. Small figures in plain dress move on the terraces and stairs, with some scaffolding on the right and a few small fires and smoke near the base. The painting fills the whole frame in an oil-painting style, with no visible text.
